description: Oakland Bike Parking is a dataset listed in City of Oakland open data portal (data.oaklandca.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a city, published or maintained by City of Oakland. To download a projected shapefile of this dataset, please click "Download Projected Shapefile: Oakland Bike Parking" under "Attachments" below. This feature class includes data on publicly-accessible bicycle parking known to be installed in Oakland. Most of the bike racks were installed by the City of Oakland on public sidewalks. Coverage: Oakland. The portal files it under the category Infrastructure. Its tags are bike racks, bike corral, bike parking, bike rack, bike stations. The table has 24 columns. Attribution on the portal: City of Oakland, Bicycle & Pedestrian Program. The portal shows 2026-08-04 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-oaklandca-gov-portal.
